parent_objective: design damped/backtracking exact-objective projection repair after M1640 optimizer-step instability
blocked_by: M1640 Adam lr=1e-3 projection overshot the controlled scale_1e-3 perturbation and did not reduce exact residual
supersedes: rerunning M1640 with ad hoc learning-rate tuning

public_gates: M1642 must design a damped/backtracking projection repair before any rerun
M1642 must keep optimization scope to actor_mean.weight and actor_mean.bias
M1642 must keep diagnostics zero-weight and donor-plus actions excluded from loss
M1642 must pre-register trust-region and exact-residual acceptance rules
M1642 must keep checkpoint artifacts PPO promotion private holdout and actor-input changes blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat diagnostics as positive targets
do not treat donor_plus_hidden_action as a loss target

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a bounded damped/backtracking projection route after the M1640 optimizer-step negative result
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no projection rerun, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design weakens role guardrails
stop if design routes directly to checkpoint artifact PPO promotion or private holdout
stop if design lacks deterministic step-size/backtracking selection rule
stop if design does not address public-row overfit risk
fallback_plan: admit one bounded damped projection implementation if the design is complete
pivot away from actor_mean-only projection if no credible step-size rule exists
route to branch synthesis if another implementation would exceed cadence
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1641 admits damped/backtracking projection design after M1640 negative result

admission_evidence: M1640 Adam lr=1e-3 overshot the small perturbation
M1641 audited the negative result and admitted a damped/backtracking design
allowed_updates: M1642 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up implementation or synthesis manifest if design admits it
next_stage_criteria: trust-region and exact residual acceptance criteria are specified

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1642 is design-only for fixed-tensor objective repair and cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: future implementation may evaluate correct/wrong hidden exact residual but cannot claim closed-loop self-identification
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If no damped projection design is credible, stop or pivot instead of tuning public rows ad hoc.
allowed_claims: damped/backtracking projection design and next route
no projection run, no training, no PPO, no private-holdout, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A deterministic damped/backtracking projection design can address M1640 optimizer-step instability while preserving exact-objective role guardrails.
success_criteria: design specifies full-batch exact objective and diagnostic zero-weight policy
design specifies deterministic damping/backtracking candidate selection
design specifies residual and trust-region acceptance criteria
design keeps checkpoint artifacts PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims blocked
failure_criteria: design admits ad hoc learning-rate search without pre-registered selection
design lets diagnostics or donor-plus actions enter the loss target
design routes directly to checkpoint artifact PPO promotion private holdout or actor-input changes
design claims paper-level or level3 self-identification evidence
decision_rule: M1642 passes if it pre-registers a deterministic damped projection repair route before any rerun.
